verdict.rationale: Dover is a recruiting SaaS, so user-defined recurring schedules are a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows a feature for scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. The closest items don't qualify: interview scheduling is calendar booking, not workflow automation; automatic interview reminders are fixed one-off notifications; CRM campaign sequences are adjacent outreach features; and the API and MCP server are building blocks that need an external scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
